notes: Dictum 1.5.1 fixes and improves Meetings. Pause, Stop and the other buttons now stay on screen however long the meeting runs, and the meeting screen scrolls to show the whole transcript. While a meeting records, the recording pill and the screen-edge halo show, and you can pause or stop from the pill. When the other people's voices come out of your speakers, Dictum no longer transcribes them a second time from your microphone, and older meetings show the cleaned transcript too. Summaries now work with any installed local model: choose it in Settings > Meetings, keep several summaries per meeting, edit any summary (the original is kept), and make your own summary types with their own instructions. A new advanced setting can ask Windows to remove echo and background noise from the microphone; it is off until you test it on your PC.
